decision.reason: This turn measured the West facade double-door height directly from the West elevation's own labeled dimension chain (6600/3600/3000mm, cross-checked to within 12mm), converting an assumed 2.1m default into an image-supported ~2.15m value (claim_0005, adopted and applied to candidate_06 with source_refs; source_validation=pass, 0 unbuilt openings). The superseded assumption note was replaced with accurate text distinguishing this measured door from the remaining unmeasured doors. Remaining unchecked items (13 interior/main doors on F1/F2 with no numeric height labels anywhere in the elevations, the south-side mirrored corridor doors, and the minor entry wall notch) are genuine input limitations — no elevation in this drawing set carries a door height label except via the same pixel-outline method already applied to the one facade where the door is clearly isolated and calibrated (West). Attempting to also pixel-measure the interior doors is not feasible since they appear only in plan, not in any elevation, and the main/typical exterior doors on other elevations lack an isolated, unobstructed outline with a nearby calibrated dimension chain of the same quality checked here. No further useful, feasible, bounded action remains within scope; further micro-precision passes (e.g., re-deriving the same 2.15m to more decimal places) would not change fidelity. Selecting candidate_06 as final.
